title: Redirected step correspondence
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $b$ be a Boolean value, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be any configuration of $M$ on $x$. Taking one step from the redirected configuration of $c$ yields the redirected configuration of the result of taking one step from $c$ in $M$.
